create_raw_example: create a hashable RawExample dict wrapper for a single data row with nested dict and list support
wrap_file_safely: wrap a file with SafeFileWrapper to auto-close the file descriptor on object deletion
create_generator_property: create a re-iterable generator property using GeneratorMethodProperty so the generator can be iterated multiple times
register_data_source_type: register a custom type converter function with RootDataSource.register_type for a new schema data type
load_json_data: load and parse a JSON string into a Python dict or list using the load_json converter function
